slides.say: Several providers of the same context above you? Use context reads the closest one.
This Section reads the level from the section above, then provides level plus one below. Nest sections, and headings get smaller automatically.

slides.text: useContext ignores providers in its own component. It looks only above.
slides.say: Notice: use context is not affected by the provider this same component returns. It always searches upwards.

slides.text: Like CSS inheritance: override by wrapping a part of the tree. Different contexts never override each other.
slides.say: It works like CSS inheritance. A nested provider overrides the value for its part of the tree. And different contexts never override each other.
